neighbours.label: ' computer' / ' Windows' used as a modifier of a device or product (computer monitor, computer chips, Windows phone, Windows Store), and ' desktop' meaning the machine
fire: The classroom has a projector, two speakers and a computer screen mounted on the wall.
A shortage of computer chips has slowed production at several car plants.
My aunt refuses to give up the Windows phone she has carried for years.
You can buy the game from the Windows Store or directly from the developer.
He plugged the camera into a computer monitor to check the footage.
The library replaced its ageing terminals with a row of Windows tablets.
The thieves took a television, a games console and a computer keyboard.
Once you add a mouse and a big screen, the little laptop works like a desktop.
quiet: The classroom has a projector, two speakers and a whiteboard mounted on the wall.
A shortage of steel sheets has slowed production at several car plants.
My aunt refuses to give up the leather handbag she has carried for years.
You can buy the game from the toy shop or directly from the designer.
He bought a second computer last month because the first one was too slow.
The library replaced its draughty windows with a row of double-glazed panes.
The thieves took a television, a silver teapot and a mantel clock.
After the update the server runs Linux and nobody has needed to restart it.

notes: Card: ' Windows' x12, ' computer' x7, ' desktop', ' click'.
